summary: In year King Uzziah died I saw Lord sitting on throne high lifted up, train fills temple, seraphim each six wings with two cover face two cover feet two fly, one cries to another Holy holy holy is Yahweh of Armies whole earth full of glory, foundations of thresholds shake at voice, house filled smoke, Isaiah says Woe is me for I am undone for I am man unclean lips and I dwell among people unclean lips for my eyes have seen King Yahweh of Armies. Then one of seraphim flew with live coal from altar touched mouth, behold this has touched your lips iniquity taken away sin forgiven. Then heard voice of Lord Whom shall I send who will go for us? Then Isaiah said Here I am send me. Then commission: Go tell this people Keep on hearing but don't understand, seeing but don't perceive, make heart fat, ears heavy, eyes shut lest they see and turn and be healed. How long Lord? Until cities wasted without inhabitant.
whyItMatters: Call narrative and vision of holiness — holy holy holy, whole earth full of glory, live coal touching lips, Here I am send me, hardening commission. Most famous holiness vision and mission call.

keyVerses.text: One called to another, and said, “Holy, holy, holy, is Yahweh of Armies! The whole earth is full of his glory!”
keyVerses.why: Trishagion — threefold holy, earth full of glory.

keyVerses.text: Then I said, “Woe is me! For I am undone, because I am a man of unclean lips and I live among a people of unclean lips, for my eyes have seen the King, Yahweh of Armies!”
keyVerses.why: Recognition — undone unclean lips among unclean lips, yet saw King.

keyVerses.text: I heard the Lord’s voice, saying, “Whom shall I send, and who will go for us?” Then I said, “Here I am. Send me!”
keyVerses.why: Call and response — Whom shall I send? Here I am send me.

questions.question: What are seraphim with six wings covering face feet flying?
questions.answer: Seraphim = burning ones. Six wings: two cover face (reverence, cannot look directly at glory), two cover feet (modesty, perhaps euphemism for nakedness), two fly (ready for service). One cries to another antiphonally. Foundation thresholds shake, smoke fills — theophany like Sinai. Holy holy holy = threefold intensification (superlative), also later Trinity reading: holy thrice. Whole earth full of glory despite seeming unholy — vision claims earth still full of divine glory even if unseen.

questions.question: Why does Isaiah say Woe is me undone unclean lips among unclean lips?
questions.answer: Seeing King Yahweh of Armies in holiness makes Isaiah aware of uncleanness — not just moral failure but lips specifically — mouth speaks what heart is, and as prophet lips are instrument. Unclean lips among people unclean lips — corporate identity. Unlike other prophets who feel inadequate (Moses, Jeremiah), Isaiah feels polluted. Woe is me — prophetic woe oracle usually pronounced on others, now on self. Undone = destroyed, coming apart.

questions.question: What does live coal from altar touching mouth mean?
questions.answer: Seraph takes live coal with tongs from altar (burning coals where sacrifice atones) touches mouth — behold this has touched lips iniquity taken away sin forgiven/purged. Coal cauterizes, cleanses. Lips that were unclean now purged by divine initiative, not self-cleaning. Then able to speak for God. Pattern: vision of holiness, confession of uncleanness, cleansing by coal, then call — you cannot serve until cleansed.

questions.question: Why does God say go make heart fat ears heavy eyes shut lest they turn and be healed? Sounds like God wants them not to understand?
questions.answer: Hardening commission — one of hardest texts. Isaiah to preach and result will be hardening, not repentance — people keep hearing but not understanding, seeing but not perceiving. John 12:40 and Matthew 13 quote this for Jesus' parables. Does God cause hardening or predict it? Some read as judicial giving over to already hardened hearts, making prophetic word have hardening effect like sun hardens clay. How long? Until cities wasted — judgment total, then holy seed stump remains (v13) — hope after devastation, like tree stump with holy seed.

glossary.def: Burning ones — six-winged throne guardians, face feet covered, flying.
Threefold holy — superlative holiness, earth full of glory.
Burning coal from altar of atonement — touches lips, iniquity taken, sin purged.
